Cold Plunge Temperature and Time

Most cold plunge research used water below 59°F (15°C). A meta-analysis on muscle soreness found the best results at 52 to 59°F (11 to 15°C) for 11 to 15 minutes. Beginners should start warmer and much shorter, around 1 to 3 minutes, and never plunge alone.
